task_completion.description: The DICOM CT image is loaded into the Weasis viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is open showing a CT scan (cross-sectional anatomy) in the main viewport.

task_completion.description: The agent accesses the spatial filter or image processing menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A menu, dropdown, or tool panel related to 'Filters', 'Spatial Filter', or 'Image Processing' is visible.

task_completion.description: The 'Sharpen' filter is selected and applied to the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Sharpen' option is highlighted in a menu, or a dialog box for sharpening is visible, and the image in the viewport shows increased edge contrast/sharpness.

task_completion.description: The agent opens the export dialog and sets the format to TIFF and the correct path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog is visible with the file format set to TIFF and the destination path showing '~/DICOM/exports/sharpened_ct.tiff'.

task_completion.description: A text file is created with the required keyword.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) or a terminal command shows the file 'filter_applied.txt' containing the word 'sharpen'.

task_completion.description: The final files are present in the target directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal 'ls' output shows 'sharpened_ct.tiff' and 'filter_applied.txt' in the ~/DICOM/exports/ folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to apply the filter rather than command-line image processing tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse interactions with Weasis menus and sliders rather than just terminal commands like 'convert' or 'mogrify'.

integrity.description: The TIFF file was generated via the Weasis export function.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis export progress bar or export confirmation dialog is visible.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename existing files to match the target names.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the active process of configuring the export and typing the filename.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source image is a real DICOM file (0002.DCM). The agent must specifically use the 'Sharpen' filter within Weasis. The required output paths are exactly /home/ga/DICOM/exports/sharpened_ct.tiff and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/filter_applied.txt. The text file must contain the exact string 'sharpen'.
